blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) communities debate whether control policies should inherit pretrained knowledge from vision-language models or from visual generators. The debate, however, bundles three separable choices: backbone initialization, the objective applied to future observations, and whether the machinery for that future loss is kept at inference. A gap between a VLA and a WAM therefore cannot simply be attributed to any one of them. We show that decoupling these choices yields a common framework for both families, which we term Just Action Model (JAM): a pretrained visual backbone with an action expert, trained with an action loss and a foresight loss. The foresight loss trains current-observation features to predict frozen encodings of the recorded future through a prediction head discarded after training, so no visual generation is involved in either training or inference, and the backbone can be chosen freely. We first compare objectives within fixed policy architectures, then evaluate the foresight recipe across backbone families. The resulting JAM policies outperform their matched FastWAM and ImageWAM counterparts on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and achieve similar or slightly higher success rates on RoboTwin. Compared with FastWAM, JAM improves the success rates from 97.0%/55.3%/91.2% to 98.2%/64.5%/91.4%, respectively. With cached foresight targets, JAM reduces estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73% relative to FastWAM. Our results show that future supervision improves control without visual generation or additional inference machinery, and strong foresight performance is attainable with either generator-initialized or vision-language backbones. Project Page: https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言行动(VLA)和世界行动模式(WAM)社区就控制政策是否应当从视觉-语言模式或视觉生成者那里继承经过预先培训的知识展开辩论。 然而,辩论将三种可分离的选择捆绑在一起:骨干初始化、适用于未来观测的目标,以及未来损失的处理机制是否仍然处于推论之中。 因此,不能简单地将志愿军和妇女军之间的差距归咎于其中任何一个。 我们显示,把这些选择脱钩为两个家庭带来一个共同的框架,我们称之为Just Action Model(Just Action Model(JAM)):一个预先训练的视觉骨干,有一个行动专家,训练有素的动作损失和前瞻损失。 展望损失列车电流-观测功能通过训练后丢弃的预测头来预测被记录的未来被冻结的编码,因此没有视觉生成参与训练或推断,骨干可以自由选择. 我们首先比较固定政策结构中的目标,然后评价各骨干家庭的展望方案。 由此产生的JAM政策在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上超过了它们对应的FastWAM和ImageWAM,在RoboTwin上取得了相近或略高的成功率. 与FastWAM相比,JAM的成功率分别从97.0%/55.3%/91.2%提高到98.2%/64.5%/91.4%。 根据缓存的展望目标,与FastWAM相比,JAM将每个样本的在线培训FLOP估计数减少了73%. 我们的结果表明,未来的监督可以改善控制,而无需视觉生成或额外的推论机制,而利用发电机初始化或视觉语言主干线可以实现强有力的展望性能。 项目网页:https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pretrained visual models provide a starting point for robot control. Standard vision-language-action models (VLAs) adapt vision-language representations to predict actions ( Kim et al., 2025b ; Black et al., 2025a ; Black et al., 2025b ) . World-action models (WAMs) start from image or video generators and learn actions together with future visual prediction ( Ye et al., 2026b ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Bi et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . These approaches differ, as depicted in Figure 1 , in both their pretrained knowledge and how they use the robot trajectories: most VLAs learn only the actions in a trajectory, whereas a WAM also learns to generate the observations that follow. Comparing their success rates alone does not identify which difference matters.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的视觉模型为机器人控制提供了起点. 标准视觉-语言-行动模型(VLAs)调整视觉-语言表述以预测行动(Kim等人,2025b;Black等人,2025a;Black等人,2025b). 世界动作模型(WAMs)从图像或视频生成器开始,学习动作与未来的视觉预测(Ye等人,2026b;Yuan等人,2026b;Li等人,2026b;Bi等人,2026;Zhang等人,2026a). 如图1所示,这些方法各不相同,既包括预先训练的知识,也包括如何使用机器人轨迹:大多数VLA只学习轨迹中的动作,而WAM也学习生成随后的观测结果. 仅比较其成功率并不能确定哪些差异很重要。

blocks.en: We separate three choices: backbone initialization , the objective on recorded future observations , and the modules used at inference . Recent attempts such as FastWAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and ImageWAM ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) remove test-time video or image generation and suggest that visual generative objectives at training time are the key to WAMs. We ask a more basic question: does learning from recorded future observations require a visual generative objective at all? If not, can backbones without visual generative pretraining learn from future observations in the same way?
blocks.zh: 我们分离了三个选择:主干初始化、未来观测记录的目标以及推断所使用的模块。 最近的一些尝试,如FastWAM(Yuan等人,2026年)和ImageWAM(Zhang等人,2026a年)删除了测试时间的视频或图像生成,并暗示训练时间的视觉基因目标是WAM的关键. 我们提出了一个更基本的问题:从已记录的未来观测中学习,是否要求有一个直观的遗传目标? 如果没有的话,没有视觉基因前训练的骨干能否以同样的方式从未来的观测中学习?

blocks.en:
We show that predicting future representations can replace visual generative supervision in policy training.
We introduce Just Action Model (JAM), a common recipe for a pretrained visual backbone and an action expert. The policy is trained with an action loss and a foresight loss: a prediction head maps current-observation features to targets supplied by a frozen future anchor. Future observations provide targets for the foresight loss, never inputs to the action path. The anchor branch and prediction head are used only during training, and fixed targets can be cached. At deployment, the backbone encodes the current context and the action expert predicts the action chunk. JAM requires no image or video generation during policy fine-tuning or deployment. The backbone may still come from generative pretraining, and the action expert still uses flow matching.
blocks.zh:
我们显示,预测未来的表述可以取代政策培训中的视觉基因监督。
我们引入了Just Action Model(Just Action Model(JAM)),这是预训视觉骨干和动作专家的共同配方. 保险单的培训内容是动作损失和展望损失:一个预测头图,将当前观测特征映射到冻结的未来锚点提供的目标。 未来的观测为展望损失提供了目标,绝不为行动路径提供投入。 主锚分支和预测头只在训练期间使用,固定目标可以缓存. 在部署时,主干编码当前上下文,动作专家预测动作块. JAM在政策微调或部署过程中不需要图像或视频生成. 骨干可能仍然来自基因预训,动作专家仍然使用流配.

blocks.en: We evaluate the recipe in two stages. First, we replace the generative objectives of FastWAM and ImageWAM while keeping each policy’s architecture, data, optimizer, training budget, and deployment path fixed. Predicting future representations preserves or improves success, and targets at future positions are more effective than those at the current position. Backbone and future anchor pretraining play different roles: a pretrained FastWAM backbone remains effective with a randomly initialized, frozen future anchor, and direct VAE features give its strongest result. JAM (Ovis-U1) performs best with targets from the pretrained Yak backbone, so the preferred target is architecture-dependent. With the best target for each architecture, LIBERO-Plus success rises from 55.31 % 55.31\% to 64.54 % 64.54\% for FastWAM and from 65.27 % 65.27\% to 79.95 % 79.95\% for ImageWAM. With cached targets, this recipe reduces estimated online FLOPs per sample per update by 73.0 % 73.0\% for FastWAM and 36.8 % 36.8\% for ImageWAM.
blocks.zh: 我们分两个阶段评估配方。 首先,我们取代了FastWAM和ImageWAM的基因目标,同时将每个政策的架构、数据、优化器、培训预算和部署路径固定下来。 预测今后的表述将保持或改进成功,未来职位的目标比目前职位的目标更有效。 Backbone和未来的主播预训扮演不同的角色:经过预训的FastWAM主干线仍然有效,随机初始化,冻结的未来主播,直接的VAE特性给出了最强的结果. JAM(Ovis-U1)在预训的Yak主干线上的目标上表现最好,因此首选的目标依赖于架构. LIBERO-Plus的成功率是每个建筑的最佳目标,FastWAM的成功率从55.31% 55.31%提高到64.54% 64.54%,ImageWAM的成功率从65.27% 65.27%提高到79.95% 79.95%. 有了缓存目标,这个食谱将每份更新样本估计的在线FLOP减少73.0%,FastWAM减少73.0%,ImageWAM减少36.8%36.8%.

blocks.en: Second, we retain the common foresight objective and instantiate it with generative, self-supervised, and vision-language backbones. On LIBERO-Plus, JAM (Ovis-U1), JAM (DINOv2-L), and JAM (Qwen3.5-2B) reach 79.95 % 79.95\% , 70.39 % 70.39\% , and 81.14 % 81.14\% , against 65.27 % 65.27\% for ImageWAM (Ovis-U1), which is trained with the generation loss ℒ G \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{G}} . These results establish the recipe’s applicability across all three families: generative backbones can learn from future observations without a visual generative loss, and the same supervision applies to non-generative backbones.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们保留共同的展望目标,并用基因、自我监督和视觉语言的骨干加以即兴发挥。 在LIBERO-Plus上,JAM(Ovis-U1)、JAM(DINOv2-L)和JAM(Quen3.5-2B)分别达到79.95%、79.95%、70.39 %、81.14%、81.14 %、65.27%、65.27 %。 这些结果确定了食谱对所有三个家族的可适用性:基因骨干可以从未来的观察中学习而不会出现视觉基因损失,同样的监督适用于非基因骨干.

blocks.en: Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • We propose JAM, a single recipe for a pretrained visual backbone and an action expert in which recorded future observations enter only as frozen prediction targets, and the foresight branch is discarded after training. • We show through fixed-architecture comparisons that foresight can replace visual generation while preserving or improving success. Future-offset targets are more effective than current-offset targets, and the best target depends on the backbone: a plain VAE suffices for the Wan video backbone. With targets cached, JAM reduces the estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73.0 % 73.0\% relative to FastWAM. • We apply the same objective to generative, self-supervised, and vision-language backbones, with the strongest generative and vision-language instantiations achieving comparable control performance, showing that strong performance with foresight is attainable using either a generator-initialized or a vision-language backbone.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提议建立JAM,这是预先训练的视觉骨干和一位行动专家的单一配方,其中记录了未来的观测结果,只是作为冻结的预测目标输入,而展望处则在培训后被丢弃。 我们通过固定建筑结构的比较表明,展望可以取代视觉生成,同时保持或改进成功。 未来抵消目标比当前抵消目标更有效,最佳目标取决于骨干:一个普通的VAE就足够Wan视频骨干了. 随着目标被缓存,JAM将每个样本的在线培训FLOP估计数比FastWAM减少73.0% 73.0QQ. 我们把同样的目标应用于基因、自我监督和视觉语言的骨干,最强的基因和视觉语言的瞬间实现类似的控制性能,表明有远见的强大性能可以使用发电机初始化或视觉语言的骨干来实现。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: OpenVLA adapts a vision-language model to autoregressive action prediction; π 0 \pi_{0} and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} pair vision-language backbones with flow-matching action experts ( Kim et al., 2025b ; Black et al., 2025a ; Black et al., 2025b ) . WAMs combine generator initialization with future visual prediction ( Ye et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Bi et al., 2026 ) . FastWAM retains video co-training without test-time video generation ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) ; ImageWAM uses an image-editing backbone and a future-image target ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . JAM replaces their visual generation objectives while preserving each policy’s architecture and deployment path, separating the use of pretrained generators from the need to generate during policy training.
blocks.zh: OpenVLA将一个视觉语言模型用于自动递归动作预测;π 0\pi_{0}和π 0.5\pi_{0.5}双视觉语言主干线与流配对动作专家(Kim等人,2025b;Black等人,2025a;Black等人,2025b). WAMs将发电机初始化与未来的视觉预测相结合(Ye等人,2026a; Ye等人,2026年b;Li等人,2026年b;Bi等人,2026年b). FastWAM保留视频联合训练,不进行测试时视频生成(袁等,2026年);ImageWAM使用图像编辑主干和未来图像目标(张等,2026a). JAM取代了他们的视觉生成目标,同时保留了每个政策的架构和部署路径,将预先训练的发电机的使用与在政策培训中产生的需要分开.

blocks.en: Future observations support planning and predictive supervision ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Cheang et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Joint-embedding methods avoid pixel reconstruction ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Daithankar et al., 2026 ) ; Var-JEPA studies a variational formulation on tabular data ( Gögl and Yau, 2026 ) . Mirai and Video-Mirai apply foresight to image and video generation ( Yu et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2026a ) . For control, FRAPPE aligns policy features with multiple future representations, VLAFlow pairs latent alignment with language-supervised co-training, and Being-H0.7 aligns a deployable prior with a future-informed posterior ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . VLA-JEPA uses frozen video targets for human-video pretraining and joint representation and action learning ( Sun et al., 2026 ) ; PFD distills future-conditioned action residuals into a current-only FastWAM policy while retaining video co-training and a deployed residual adapter ( Fang et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en:
FLARE mixes future, state, and action tokens through self-attention in the action DiT ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . JEPA-WAM supervises a shared action-generating predictor using dense joint current–future targets in a frozen V-JEPA space. Its pretrained-VLA instantiation preserves the original pathways and removes the prediction branch at deployment ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .
JAM differs from FLARE in where prediction is applied: a separate training-only head supervises existing visual-backbone tokens, preserving the matched policy’s action computation. In contrast to JEPA-WAM’s joint current–future V-JEPA target, it supervises future-position features in a target space chosen for each backbone. This common recipe replaces visual generation in existing WAMs and extends across generative, self-supervised, and vision-language backbones. Appendix E gives further comparisons and more related work.
blocks.zh:
FLARE通过在DiT行动(郑等人,2025年)中的自我关注将未来、状态和行动符号混合在一起。 JEPA-WAM在冻结的V-JEPA空间使用密集的联合电流-未来目标来监督一个共同的动作生成预测器. 其预训-VLA即时化能保留原有路径,并在部署时移除预测分支(Lin等人,2026年).
JAM与应用预测的FLARE不同:一个单独的训练单头监督现有的视觉背骨符号,保留匹配的政策动作计算. 与JEPA-WAM的联合当前-未来V-JEPA目标不同,它监督为每个骨干选择的目标空间中的未来位置特征. 这种共同的食谱取代了现有WAM中的视觉生成,并扩展到基因,自我监督,和视觉语言的骨干. 附 录 E提供了进一步的比较和更多的相关工作。

The recorded futures are unused, and pretrained weights enter through policy initialization. The WAM reference starts from a pretrained generator and adds its generative loss ℒ G \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{G}} on the recorded futures, ℒ WAM = ℒ act + λ G ​ ℒ G . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{WAM}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{act}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{G}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{G}}.\vskip-5.69054pt (2) This term ties the recipe to a generator: it needs a decoder or denoising path during training, and in some WAMs also at inference.
JAM pairs a backbone with an action expert and optimizes ℒ JAM = ℒ act + λ F ​ ℒ F , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{JAM}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{act}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{F}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{F}},\vskip-5.69054pt (3) as shown in Figure 2 . blocks.en: 3.3 Instantiations across pretraining families
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训前家庭的证明

blocks.en: We instantiate JAM with backbones from three pretraining families. In the cross-backbone comparison in Table 3 , each future anchor is a frozen copy of the corresponding backbone. Our matched FastWAM and ImageWAM experiments additionally evaluate VAE-direct future anchors.
blocks.zh: 我们用3个预训家庭的骨干来对JAM进行即兴表演. 在表3中的交叉背骨比较中,每个未来的主播都是对应主干的一个冷冻拷贝. 我们的FastWAM和ImageWAM实验 额外评价了VAE引导的未来主播.

blocks.en: FastWAM pairs a Wan2.2-5B video backbone with an action expert of the same depth, and ImageWAM (Ovis-U1) pairs the pretrained Yak18 image-editing backbone with an 18-block action expert of matching width ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Their generative objectives denoise future video latents and generate a future image. Under JAM, the backbone sees only the clean current frame, and the policy architecture and action-expert initialization are unchanged. Two further targets isolate what the frozen generator contributes: the same backbone with random initialization, which keeps the architecture but removes the pretrained features, and the frozen VAE tokenizer alone, which removes the target transformer and predicts lifted latent-patch features.
blocks.zh: FastWAM配对一个Wan2.2-5B视频主干线,具有相同深度的动作专家,ImageWAM(Ovis-U1)配对一个经过预训的Yak18图像编辑主干线,配对一个18块匹配宽度的动作专家(Team Wan等人,2025年;袁等人,2026年;张等人,2026年a). 他们的基因目标 将未来视频的潜伏 并产生未来的形象。 在JAM下,骨干只看到干净的当前框架,政策架构和行动专家初始化没有变化. 另有两个目标隔离了被冻结的生成器的贡献:一个是相同的主干线,随机初始化,它保持了架构但移除了预先训练的特征,另一个是仅冷冻的VAE示意器,它移除了目标变压器,并预测了被解除的潜刻特征.

blocks.en: DINOv2 is an image encoder with no language input and no generative head ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) . The action expert mirrors the backbone’s transformer blocks, and a separate text encoder supplies instruction features to the action expert, but not to the visual backbone.
blocks.zh: DINOv2是一个图像编码器,没有语言输入,也没有基因头(Oquab等人,2024年). 动作专家反射主干线的变压器块,单独的文本编码器向动作专家提供指令功能,但不能向视觉主干线提供.

blocks.en: Qwen3.5-2B is a vision-language model that already reads images and text together ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . The action expert mirrors the backbone’s blocks and reads the backbone’s tokens through causal token mixing over image, text, and action tokens, so it is a VLA trained with an additional foresight loss.
blocks.zh: Quen3.5-2B是一个视觉语言模型,已经一起阅读图像和文本(Quen Team,2026年). 行动专家对骨干块进行反射,通过在图像、文字和动作符上混合的因果符来读取骨干符,因此它是一个经过训练的VLA,其前瞻损失更大。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Our study has two stages. First, we replace visual generation with foresight within fixed policy architectures and deployment paths, examining target offsets and future anchors. Second, we apply the common objective to backbones from different pretraining families. We also compare the resulting policies with published systems and evaluate training cost.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有两个阶段。 首先,我们用固定政策结构和部署路径中的远见来取代视觉生成,审查目标抵消和未来锚点。 第二,我们把共同目标应用于来自不同预训家庭的骨干。 我们还将由此产生的政策与公布的系统进行比较,并评估培训费用。

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: LIBERO contains the Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long suites ( Liu et al., 2023 ) . We evaluate 40 tasks with 50 rollouts each and report success per suite and averaged across suites. For LIBERO-Plus, we follow ImageWAM’s 15 % 15\% subset protocol ( Fei et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) : a seeded draw per suite produces a fixed manifest of 1,506 1{,}506 perturbed tasks, evaluated once each and shared by all local policies. RoboTwin 2.0 evaluates 50 bimanual tasks under Clean and Randomized settings ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: LIBERO包含空间,对象,目标,和长套房(Liu等人,2023年). 我们评价40项任务,每套50项,每套报告成功情况,平均各套。 对LIBERO-Plus来说,我们遵循ImageWAM15%的15QQ子协议(Fei et al., 2026;Zhang et al., 2026a):每个套房的种子抽图产生固定的1,506 1{,}506个扰动任务,每套一次评估一次,并由所有地方政策共享。 RoboTwin 2.0在清洁和随机设置下评价50项双人任务(Chen等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Each generative policy and its foresight counterpart share data, policy architecture, optimizer, training budget, and evaluator. Training budgets follow FastWAM and ImageWAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . On LIBERO, the FastWAM recipe runs 20 20 k updates and the ImageWAM recipe, used by the other backbones, 21.7 21.7 k, both at global batch 128. On RoboTwin 2.0, both recipes run five epochs, 29,355 29{,}355 updates at global batch 1,024 1{,}024 for FastWAM and 69,900 69{,}900 at global batch 384 for ImageWAM.

blocks.en: Having replaced visual generation with foresight and compared different target representations, we next examine the role of backbone pretraining and whether the same recipe extends beyond generative backbones. Table 3 separates backbone and future anchor initialization for JAM (Wan). With a pretrained visual backbone, pretrained and random Wan targets reach 97.45 % 97.45\% and 97.65 % 97.65\% on LIBERO. With a random visual backbone, they reach 71.15 % 71.15\% and 84.40 % 84.40\% . Pretrained backbone weights are important in both matched-target comparisons, whereas a random target remains effective. A frozen random future anchor supplies stable, input-dependent features of the recorded future, not independently sampled noise. Together with the VAE results in Table 1 , this shows that the future anchor need not use the same pretrained backbone as the policy, while the policy backbone still relies on pretraining for strong control performance.

blocks.en: We next ask whether the recipe requires a generative backbone or can also be applied to other types of backbones. For vision-language Qwen3.5-2B, adding foresight raises LIBERO-Plus success from 77.03 % 77.03\% to 81.14 % 81.14\% with policy architecture and training settings fixed. Table 3 compares the generative Ovis-U1, self-supervised DINOv2-B/L, and vision-language Qwen3.5-2B backbones under the same action-plus-foresight objective (Section 3.3 ). JAM (Ovis-U1) reaches 96.75 % 96.75\% on LIBERO and 79.95 % 79.95\% on LIBERO-Plus, and JAM (Qwen3.5-2B) reaches 96.55 % 96.55\% and 81.14 % 81.14\% . blocks.en: 4.5 Training cost

blocks.en: JAM reduces online training cost by processing only the current observation in the trainable visual branch and caching fixed targets. With cached foresight targets, the estimated cost per sample per update falls from 15.52 15.52 TFLOPs for FastWAM to 4.19 4.19 for JAM (Wan), a 73.0 % 73.0\% reduction. Generation denoises a nine-frame window that the video VAE must also encode, whereas cached foresight uses only the current frame online. With cached Yak targets, the estimated cost falls from 5.81 5.81 TFLOPs for ImageWAM (Ovis-U1) to 3.67 3.67 for JAM (Ovis-U1), a 36.8 % 36.8\% reduction. Its generative branch predicts only one future frame, and both objectives process the text context. Measured on one GH200, the GPU time of the operations covered by these estimates falls by 67.3 % 67.3\% and 37.8 % 37.8\% in the same two comparisons. Appendix B details the FLOP estimates and GPU-time measurements.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: JAM bridges vision-language-action and world-action models by separating backbone initialization, supervision on future observations, and the modules retained at inference. It trains a pretrained visual backbone and an action expert with action and foresight losses, using frozen future representations as targets and discarding the foresight branch after training. With the policy architecture fixed, replacing visual generation with foresight yields higher success rates than the corresponding generative baselines on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the largest gains on LIBERO-Plus; RoboTwin 2.0 success is similar or slightly higher. With cached targets, JAM reduces online FLOPs per sample per update by 73.0 % 73.0\% relative to FastWAM and 36.8 % 36.8\% relative to ImageWAM. With the recipe fixed, the same supervision applies to generative, self-supervised, and vision-language backbones, and the best generator-initialized and vision-language policies achieve comparable performance. These results show that effective foresight training is possible with either pretraining family, while the cross-backbone comparison does not isolate the effect of pretraining alone. Both families can be trained as Just Action Models that learn from recorded futures without visual generation during policy training or additional inference machinery.
blocks.zh: JAM通过分离骨干初始化,对未来观测的监督,以及推论中保留的模块,将视觉-语言-行动和世界-行动模型连接起来. 它培训一名经过预先训练的视觉骨干和行动专家,以行动和展望损失为主,利用被冻结的未来表述作为目标,并在培训后抛弃展望处。 随着政策架构的固定,以远见取代视觉生成,其成功率高于LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上相应的基因基线,在LIBERO-Plus上收益最大;RoboTwin 2.0成功率相似或略高. 有了缓存目标,JAM将每个样本每次更新的在线FLOP相对FastWAM减少73.0% 73.0\%,相对于ImageWAM减少36.8% 36.8\%. 随着食谱的固定,同样的监督适用于基因,自我监督,和视觉语言骨干,最佳的生成者初始化和视觉语言政策可以实现相似的性能. 这些结果表明,无论是预先培训家庭,都有可能进行有效的展望培训,而交叉背骨比较并不能孤立预先培训的效果。 两个家庭都可以作为Just Action Models接受培训,在政策培训或额外推论机制期间从记录的未来中学习,而不用视觉生成.

blocks.en: The 24-layer backbone encodes each view separately alongside the instruction, without a separate text encoder. Its action expert copies compatible weights from 18 GatedDeltaNet and six full-attention blocks and adds action input, output, and flow-time modules. Future-image features supervise current-image features at the same layer; future views never enter the policy prefix.

blocks.en: Each encoder processes views separately. A frozen DINOv2 copy encodes each future view into final-layer patch targets for the corresponding policy layer.

blocks.en: C.5 Action-only controls

blocks.en: To measure the contribution of foresight, we compare training with and without it for Qwen3.5-2B and DINOv2-L. Each pair in Table 14 uses the same architecture and training settings. blocks.en: C.6 Separate action expert or shared weights
blocks.zh: C.6 单独的行动专家或共同权重

blocks.en: We test whether foresight training requires a separate action expert by sharing the Qwen3.5 backbone weights for action prediction. The 3.60B policy includes a 2.21B backbone, a 1.38B action expert, and a small state projector. The expert copies decoder blocks without duplicating the vision encoder or token embeddings. With the objective and training budget fixed, Table 15 reports 81.14 % 81.14\% LIBERO-Plus success with the expert, versus 79.61 % 79.61\% and 80.68 % 80.68\% with shared 2B and 4B backbones. The recipe also works without a separate expert. In these single-run comparisons, the expert achieves similar observed success to shared 4B with fewer parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们通过分享行动预测的Qwen3.5骨干权重来检验展望培训是否需要一位单独的行动专家。 3.60B政策包括一个2.21B骨干,一个1.38B行动专家,以及一个小型的州投影仪. 专家复制解码器块而不重复视觉编码器或符号嵌入. 随着目标和培训预算的确定,表15报告了81.14%与专家合作的LIBERO-Plus成功率,而79.61%为79.61%,80.68%为80.68%,共享2B和4B骨干。 食谱同样没有单独的专家来操作. 在这些单运行的比较中,专家取得了类似的观察到的成功,共享4B的参数较少.

blocks.en: Appendix E Extended related work
blocks.zh: 附录E 延长的相关工作

blocks.en: Video-based policies and joint visual–action models combine action learning with visual prediction ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Cheang et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . VPP and Seer connect predictive visual features to control ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) . Other policies use generated observations or predictive latent context during action selection ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 视频政策和联合视觉-行动模型将动作学习与视觉预测结合起来(Wu等人,2024年;Cheang等人,2024年;Guo等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年)。 VPP和Seer将预测视觉特征连接到控制上(Hu等人,2025年;Tian等人,2025年)。 其他政策使用在选择行动时产生观测结果或预测潜在背景(Zhang等人,2026b); Li等人,2026年a; 王等, 2026; 黄等, 2026).

blocks.en: V-JEPA 2-AC trains an action-conditioned predictor on robot trajectories using frozen video features, then uses latent rollouts for model-predictive control toward an image goal ( Assran et al., 2025 ) . JAM uses future targets to learn policy representations for imitation learning. It discards the prediction head after training and samples actions without latent rollouts or planning.
blocks.zh: V-JEPA( 日本) 2-AC利用冷冻视频特性在机器人轨迹上训练一个动作条件化的预测器,然后利用潜在的推展,对图像目标进行模型预测控制(Assran等人,2025年)。 JAM利用未来的目标来学习模仿学习的政策表述. 它在培训后抛弃了预测头,并在没有潜在推出或规划的情况下取样行动。

blocks.en: FLARE mixes future, state, and action tokens in the action DiT ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . FRAPPE retains multiple prefix-and-LoRA streams at inference ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . VLAFlow’s MindWPI adds current-observation V-JEPA context accessible to action tokens ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . JAM supervises existing visual-backbone tokens through a separate training-only head, preserving the matched baseline’s action computation.
blocks.zh: FLARE在动作DiT(郑等人,2025年)中混合了未来,状态,动作符号. FRATPE在推论中保留了多个前缀和-洛拉流(赵等人,2026年). VLAFlow的MindWPI增加了当前观察V-JEPA的可访问动作符号背景(Xia等人,2026年). JAM通过单独的只训练头来监督现有的视觉背骨符号,保留匹配的基准动作计算.

blocks.en: REPA aligns diffusion features with visual representations, AGRA adds semantic alignment to WAM co-training, and Video-Mirai adds foresight to autoregressive video diffusion; all retain visual generation ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026a ) . WAM4D adds structured visual supervision to world-action learning ( Li et al., 2026c ) . JAM removes visual generation during policy fine-tuning and uses no predicted future features as action inputs.
blocks.zh: REPA将传播特征与视觉表现相配合,AGRA在WAM的协同训练中增加了语义对齐,Video-Mirai在自递视频传播中增加了前瞻;都保留了视觉生成(Yu等人,2025年;Qiu等人,2026年;Yu等人,2026年a). WAM4D为世界行动学习增加了结构化的视觉监督(Li等人,2026c.). JAM在政策微调时取消了视觉生成,没有使用预测的未来特性作为行动投入.

blocks.en: Frozen random encoders map input images to targets ( Burda et al., 2019 ; Sarnthein et al., 2023 ) . Noise As Targets learns assignments to fixed random vectors ( Bojanowski and Joulin, 2017 ) . EMA encoders update their weights during training ( Grill et al., 2020 ) . Table 10 compares frozen pretrained and EMA future anchors. Table 3 and Appendix D.1 vary the initialization of the policy and frozen future anchor.
blocks.zh: 冻结随机编码器将输入图像映射到目标(Burda等人,2019年;Sarnthein等人,2023年). 噪音 As Noise As Targets 学习对固定随机向量的任务(Bojanowski and Joulin, 2017) . EMA编码器在训练期间更新其权重(Grill等人,2020年). 表10比较了被冻结的预训锚和EMA未来锚。 表3和附录D.1改变了政策的初始化和冻结的未来锚点。
